en.name: Dark Knight
en.ability: Each night*, you learn which Outsider players died today, and guess their characters: if you guess correctly, a player dies. [+1 Outsider]

revisions.v1: Each night*, you learn which Outsider players died today, and guess their characters: if you guess correctly, a player dies. [+1 Outsider]

en.otherNightReminder: Wake the Dark Knight & point to the Outsider players who died today. They guess those players' Outsider characters.
